title: What is a revolution?
goal: Say what a revolution is and how it differs from a coup, using relative clauses.

items: Say what a revolution is for historians.
Say how a revolution differs from a coup and from a rebellion.
Name the 20th-century revolutions of Latin America and their years.
Use relative clauses with *que* to say which people and which rulers.
I can say what a revolution is for historians.
I can say how a revolution differs from a coup and from a rebellion.
I can name the 20th-century revolutions of Latin America and their years.
I can use relative clauses with *que* to say which people and which rulers.
